title: AI Chipmaker Biren Taps Market Again in $515 Million Share Sale
key_facts: Shanghai Biren Technology said on 8 Oct 2026 that it will place 130 million new H-shares at HK$31.08 each, raising about HK$4.04 billion, roughly $515 million.
The price is a discount of close to 9.76% to Biren's last close and 13.73% to its five-day average.
The new shares are about 9.54% of the existing H-share count and 5% of total shares outstanding; no shareholder vote is required.
It is Biren's third capital raise since its January IPO, after a July placement that raised about $892.5 million.
About 70% of net proceeds fund supply chain procurement, production ramp-up and commercialisation of the next-generation GPU line; 20% R&D and software; 10% working capital.
Biren is one of China's so-called Four Little Dragons in GPUs, alongside Moore Threads and MetaX.
quote_evidence: Shanghai Biren Technology will place 130 million new H-shares at HK$31.08 each, raising about HK$4.04 billion, roughly $515 million, with no shareholder vote required.
why_it_matters_hint: A Chinese GPU maker is raising cash to build chips that compete with Nvidia; the placement dilutes existing holders by about 5%.
